title: A bulk import stored recipient numbers without a dial code for one group of users
question: A group of users say the verification code never arrives for them, while others are fine. What is going on?

expected.notes: Failures are confined to one group of users whose numbers were stored in local format (no dial code) by a bulk import. The failure wording in the mock is a placeholder and the report must say the real wording is unconfirmed. Unlike S1a and S1b the repositories are clean and the cause sits in the user data; the report says releases were ruled out only if it checked them.
